heroHeadline: FDA Outbreak Table Confirms Seven Active Cyclospora Investigations as CDC's Weekly Updates Remain Paused
heroSubtitle: FDA's CORE outbreak table lists seven separate active Cyclospora investigations as of Sept 3, together totaling 11,739 cases — 11,458 of them still tied to the Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce outbreak across 20 states. CDC's federal multistate page remains frozen at those Aug 27 figures after the agency confirmed Sept 4 it is reducing update frequency, and by Sept 4 only 13 of the 41 states that ever published case data still maintained a public dashboard. Indiana closed its own count at 2,104 cases Sept 3, food-safety attorney Bill Marler's independent fifty-state tally has climbed to roughly 33,525, and all thirteen congressional letters sent since mid-July remain unanswered with no hearing scheduled.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
